items.name: River Rafting
items.alt: Group river rafting on the Ganga near rocky hills
items.text: Rafting in Shivpuri on the Ganga, arranged on request for individuals and groups staying in our cottages or riverside tents.

items.name: Beach-side Camping
items.alt: Evening campfire at a riverside camp
items.text: Our signature experience: riverside camping on the Ganga beach at Shivpuri, with meals included, starry skies and the sound of the river.

items.name: Bonfire Nights
items.alt: Bonfire night at The Samsaara resort in Shivpuri
items.text: Bonfire evenings by the river with music, snacks and stories after a day of rafting.

items.name: Swimming Pool
items.alt: Swimming pool and thatched huts at The Samsaara resort, Shivpuri
items.text: Cool off in the resort swimming pool after a day of rafting and adventure in Rishikesh.

items.name: Garden Swings & Group Games
items.alt: Thatched gazebo with a garden swing at The Samsaara, Shivpuri
items.text: Lawns, swings and thatched gazebos for beach volleyball, indoor and outdoor games and team activities.

items.name: Karaoke & Music
items.alt: Outdoor music stage with lights for karaoke nights at The Samsaara
items.text: An outdoor stage, lights and music for karaoke nights, DJ evenings and celebrations.

items.name: Pre-wedding Shoots
items.alt: Tree decorated with fairy lights, a pre-wedding shoot spot at The Samsaara
items.text: Fairy-lit trees, the river, the hills and golden-hour light make a beautiful backdrop for your shoot.

items.name: River Front
items.alt: Rocky Ganga river front and forested hills at Shivpuri, Rishikesh
items.text: Walk down to the Ganga from the resort, watch the water and take in the Himalayan foothills around Shivpuri.
